other_conditions: Must be registered under the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
Must have at least one year of regular membership with the Board.
Must have an active membership of the Board.
Benefit can be availed only once in a lifetime.
To avail the benefit, the worker must add a minimum of 90 days of work experience in the preceding year.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹4,500 for purchasing a sewing machine for eligible women construction workers.
